panels.description: COLORADO CSG FACILITY — DAY. Roman sits at a worktable with a hospital treatment schedule, unapproved T-ALL chemistry file, and restricted-access form. His bonded TJ stands beside the papers. Leave upper-left clear.
Croft places his silver medical-alert bracelet beside the restricted file without touching Roman. Leave top third clear.
Croft turns the treatment schedule toward Roman. His controlled expression shows exhaustion. Leave upper-left clear.
Roman signs the restricted-access form. His bonded TJ displays a status pulse. Roman's hand remains on the pen. Leave upper-right clear.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: The approved route is too slow.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: By the time it is approved, there may be no patient left to approve it for.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: I’ll run the chemistry. I keep the records.
